output.summary: The rise in ED length of stay for admitted patients is almost entirely boarding (about 3.0 of 3.2 h). Boarding jumped in March 2026, when the hospitalist rounding change moved medical-ward discharge orders from 11:50 to 15:25. Surgical wards did not shift. ED RN hours per visit, vacancy and staffing-grid compliance are flat, and volume, acuity, staffed beds and occupancy are unchanged. The 4 West huddle pilot halved boarding (2.3 vs 4.6 h). Huddle days were set by a rotation made before the pilot, so the result is quasi-randomized, and other wards showed no spillover. The better action is extending the huddle. Travel nurses funded by deferring case managers, or pulling the 4 West charge nurse, would be harmful. The September evening cleaning cut is unproven and came after the rise.
